name: Zhennan Shi
description: Researcher whose 2007 master's work concerned web GIS.
story: In 2007, Zhennan Shi completed MSc research at University of Waikato titled “A Web-based Geographical Information System for Low Bandwidth Access”. The study built a browser GIS using the Google Maps API and a web server to present agricultural information, examining delivery under low-bandwidth conditions.
